full_page.content:
Page 15 Cont.
Jan. Geo. Sikanjer - 19 - diabetes since 3 now unconscious for two weeks - Enrolled To-day in Ser Masses
Agnes LaBelle - 40 - nerveous - druling .... moaning
20 Ellen Staats - 7 - Maningitis - T.B. of brain ... No record of a cure of this kind. . Father methodist.
21st Jean Carol McGee - 7 - modest little girl - liver cancer - Drs sent her home as a case beyond repair ..... Enrolled Dec. 12 '41 and again To-day 1.00
21 Maria Satnikoff - 25 - Greek -orth. - in accident Jan. 8 - still un- conscious - Enrolled % phone To-day
Page 16
Jan. 27 Geno Mazzapelli - 4 - lukemia - hopeless according to science
28 Thanks - Mrs. Kolthoff - bleeding ulcers of intestines ... 3 months in hospital - 13 blood-transfusions. All seemed vain. Drs. fave. - is here in
Thanks ... Little Jean McGee - 7 - prayed for last week decidedly im- proving ...... Deo Gr.
29th Carry Fraley - 53 - gall-stones .... anxious too-about 80 yr old Father.
30th Jules Oullette - 30 - sleeping now for 3 weeks. Has had such - - before but never so long before.
Etheleen Company - 47 - broken knee.
Hermine Browe - little girl fell a few days ago - cut artery in hand and loss of hand feared.
Donald Bachler - 21 - inlisting Nick
Page 17
Dec. 30th Wm F. Shaw - 59 - Episcopel.
Jane Cath. Schneider - 19 - glandular trouble about 5 yrs .....
